meta.title: SwitchAssignByGroup
meta.description: Fired by tapping the 'By Group' radio on the Assign screen while it's showing 'By Contact'. Doesn't change the underlying selection (session:selectedSignalIds is untouched) — it only flips how that selection is summarized: the CONTACTS chip row (all senders) is replaced by a GROUPS chip row (distinct groups among the selection, excluding any signal with no group).
